keywords: 23 个 Glamsterdam EIP 进入 Last Call
summary: Justin Drake 呼吁行业冷静开始规划“bunker mode”，建议有序把资产迁到公钥仍藏在哈希后的新地址，引发大范围讨论。nero_eth 列出进入 Last Call 的 23 个 Glamsterdam EIP，Sepolia gas 用量升到 83M。CPerezz 在 ethresear.ch 讨论 SETCODEFROM 留下的无主字节码。

items.topic: SETCODEFROM 留下的字节码谁来清理
items.title: ethresear.ch：SETCODEFROM 的遗留字节码与面向未来的设计选择
items.note: 04:00（CPerezz）。客户端本来就保存没有账户指向的字节码，EIP-8058 在一个 Cancun 时的全同步节点上数出 27,869 份，过去因为代码不在状态根里而无害。提议进 Hegotá 的 SETCODEFROM 给每笔交易一种新方式留下代码，分区二叉树（PBT）又把代码放进状态根，两者叠加后，全同步和快照同步的节点会在代码库内容上不一致。作者主张趁 EIP-8298 还是草案时定下规则。
items.title_en: ethresear.ch: who cleans up the code? SETCODEFROM's dangling bytecode and futureproof design choices
items.note_en: 04:00 (CPerezz). Clients already keep bytecode that no account points to; EIP-8058 counted 27,869 such entries on a full-synced node as of Cancun, harmless so far because code sits outside the state root. SETCODEFROM, proposed for Hegotá, gives every transaction a new way to leave code behind, and the partitioned binary tree (PBT) moves code inside the state root. Combined, full-synced and snap-synced nodes would disagree on what is in their code databases. The author argues for settling the rules while EIP-8298 is still a draft.

summary_en: Justin Drake called on the industry to calmly start planning for "bunker mode", recommending an orderly migration of assets to fresh addresses whose public keys are still hidden behind a hash, which set off a wide debate. nero_eth listed the 23 Glamsterdam EIPs now in Last Call, and Sepolia gas usage climbed to 83M. On ethresear.ch, CPerezz examined the orphaned bytecode that SETCODEFROM leaves behind.
